# WebGL Fluid Simulation (reference)

- Upstream: https://github.com/PavelDoGreat/WebGL-Fluid-Simulation
- Demo: https://paveldogreat.github.io/WebGL-Fluid-Simulation/
- License: MIT (see LICENSE) — Copyright (c) 2017 Pavel Dobryakov

Used as **algorithmic reference** for ToonSpectrum wet-media advection / vorticity /
pressure ideas. Product code does not ship the full demo `script.js`; see
`src/domains/creator/studio-webgl-stable-fluid-core.ts` for a typed, deterministic
subset adapted for Studio evaluation (texture-first wet pin, fail-closed policy).
